title: D23 arms run with the requirements paragraph and are compared
body:
The n100 requirements files (.krn/runs/d23-comparison/n100/requirements/) lift the judge from 9/19/72 D/P/N to 61/33/6. Run the K and plain arms on the n100 units with interface+requirements appended to the task text and compare pass rates.
Proof: per-arm pass counts on the same units with requirements, against the ~10% baseline.
Scope: evals/d23/, .krn/runs/d23-comparison/.
